core.debug.title: Debug mode
core.debug.description: Writes core log lines to the PHP error log and shows the performance admin bar node.

seo.enabled.title: Output SEO tags
seo.enabled.description: Print title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter and JSON-LD.

seo.yield.title: SEO plugin yield
seo.yield.description: auto: step aside when an SEO plugin is active; never: always print; always: never print.

seo.yield_hreflang.title: Yield hreflang to SEO plugin
seo.yield_hreflang.description: When yielding, also leave hreflang tags to the plugin.

seo.yield_jetpack.title: Replace Jetpack Open Graph
seo.yield_jetpack.description: Core Open Graph wins and Jetpack Open Graph is disabled.

seo.title_separator.title: Title separator
seo.title_separator.description: Separator used by %sep% in title templates.

seo.default_og_image.title: Default social image
seo.default_og_image.description: Attachment id used when a post has no image (1200x630 recommended).

seo.breadcrumbs_owner.title: Breadcrumb schema owner
seo.breadcrumbs_owner.description: core prints BreadcrumbList; plugin leaves it to the active SEO plugin.

lazy.enabled.title: Lazy loading (master switch)
lazy.enabled.description: Master switch for every lazy loading feature.

lazy.images.title: Lazy load images
lazy.images.description: Below-the-fold images use loading=lazy. The LCP image never does.

lazy.iframes.title: Lazy load iframes and embeds
lazy.iframes.description: Iframes lazy load; YouTube and Vimeo use click-to-load facades.

lazy.fragments.title: Defer secondary blocks
lazy.fragments.description: Sidebar, related posts and similar blocks load when near the viewport, with a no-JS fallback.

lazy.sections.title: Skip rendering of off-screen sections
lazy.sections.description: Uses CSS content-visibility for below-the-fold sections.

lazy.comments.title: Load comments on demand
lazy.comments.description: Comments load on request or when linked to.

lazy.terminal.title: Load the terminal on demand
lazy.terminal.description: Terminal code and data load after the first open.

lazy.eager_count.title: Eager images
lazy.eager_count.description: Number of leading content images that are never lazy.

lazy.yield_to_plugins.title: Yield to optimisation plugins
lazy.yield_to_plugins.description: Do not lazy load images or iframes when another plugin already does.

lazy.embed_thumbnails.title: Embed facade thumbnails
lazy.embed_thumbnails.description: local: no third-party requests before click; remote: show the provider thumbnail.

perf.disable_emoji.title: Remove emoji scripts
perf.disable_emoji.description: Removes the emoji detection script and styles on the front end.

perf.disable_embeds.title: Remove wp-embed
perf.disable_embeds.description: Removes wp-embed and oEmbed discovery on the front end.

perf.dashicons_guests.title: Remove Dashicons for visitors
perf.dashicons_guests.description: Dashicons are only needed for logged-in users.

perf.jquery_frontend.title: jQuery on the front end
perf.jquery_frontend.description: auto removes jQuery when nothing depends on it.

perf.block_css_granular.title: Load block CSS on demand
perf.block_css_granular.description: Core and custom block styles load only when the block is used.

perf.remove_head_noise.title: Clean the document head
perf.remove_head_noise.description: Removes generator, RSD, WLW and shortlink output.

features.hide_featured_in_list.title: Hide featured posts from the latest list
features.hide_featured_in_list.description: Enable hide featured posts from the latest list.

content.profile_user_id.title: Profile user
content.profile_user_id.description: User shown in About me and schema Person (0 = first administrator).

content.topics_strategy.title: Top topics order
content.topics_strategy.description: count: most posts first; manual: curated list.

content.topics_manual.title: Curated topics
content.topics_manual.description: Tag ids in display order (used by the manual strategy).

i18n.default.title: Default language
i18n.default.description: Language code of the default language.

i18n.languages.title: Languages
i18n.languages.description: Language codes used by this site.

i18n.switch_locale.title: Switch WordPress locale per post
i18n.switch_locale.description: Render core UI strings in the language of the post.

terminal.open_by_default.title: Open by default
terminal.open_by_default.description: Open the dock on page load.

terminal.max_posts.title: Maximum posts in the file system

terminal.banner.title: Banner text
terminal.banner.description: First line shown when the terminal opens.
